name: commons-balloon-actions-v1
description: ⭐ CONTROL 2 OF 2, DEAN'S FOUR-BALLOON SCHEME ALONE (12/09/2026), no Village Store. A flight costs ONE barn card of ANY crop (Dean's ruling; `mustDiffer` is vacuous at a cost of one, so no second leaf is needed) and pays the PLAIN BASE ACTION of the balloon's colour, routed through `performDoorAction`, the same function a central Notice Board uses. wheat Harvest · orchard Draw 2 · apiary GROW · dairy Build. ⭐ THE POINT IS THE TEACH: the module stops having rewards of its own and reuses the board mapping, which deletes its reference card and adds NOTHING to the box - three of the four balloon hexes are already the suit swatches and the fourth, magenta, already pays wheat's verb in a colour no suit has. ⛔ THERE IS NO VEGETABLE BALLOON: a flight IS the Deliver action, so a Deliver balloon self-cancels (L2). ⚠️ NAMED PASSENGER: a flight now emits `doorUsed` with via 'balloon', so a07 action inflation and a16 the door mix COUNT FLIGHTS on this arm exactly as D4 made them count a commons play. The door mix here is not comparable with the shipped game's. ⛔ C100 IS OPEN AND THE SHIPPED GAME IS THE COMMONS, so every commons leaf is pinned here BY NAME and this arm differs from reports/watchlist-2026-09-12T16-54-59-reference-v15.txt in the leaves listed and nothing else. ⛔ THE VILLAGE STORE HAS NEVER BEEN MEASURED ON THE COMMONS: every Store run of 12/09/2026 sits on the notice-board-visit stack, whose suit table (veg 43.5 / wheat 41.9 / apiary 41.2 / dairy 23.2 / orchard 17.4) is near-inverted from the shipped one (dairy 45.1 / wheat 40.2 / orchard 33.9 / apiary 29.8 / veg 18.1). Its finding that 'a device that pays for surplus pays the rich' is a finding about a DIFFERENT TABLE and may not be quoted at this one. ⛔ MAY NOT BE QUOTED: the bonus rate is a share of TURNS and never plays per turn; no level is comparable with a reference-v14 or earlier number; the hand limit of 7 is the SIMULATOR'S BOUND and not a rule (C7).
